storyline_causality_quote: The market was not watching only the fee: attacks between the United States and Iran continued, fears of a sea blockade remained, and worries about tankers passing safely did not disappear, so the sign changed but the danger at sea did not, and oil prices briefly braked before pressing the accelerator again.
comprehension_quote: On July 14, Trump withdrew the 20 percent plan and instead pointed to Gulf-state trade and investment deals with the United States, after what he called very productive talks with Middle Eastern leaders.
thinness_quote: Afterward, Brent crude futures briefly narrowed their rise, but prices soon returned near their earlier high—about 2.6 percent up, above $85 a barrel.
